scope: Fifteen sentence-adjudicated second-conjugation number forms in papers 1-43: thirteen plural predicates missing final t and two singular leže forms.
choice: Repair plural predicates to -et and the two singular leže predicates to leži; map the sole plural leže to ležet.
motivation: The same surface can represent incompatible number errors, so each site was resolved from its mathematical subject. Official second-conjugation morphology requires singular -i and plural -et.
alternatives_rejected: Global leže to ležet would corrupt two singular predicates.
Global bare-e retention leaves thirteen overt plural agreement errors.
Sentence recasting is unnecessary where exact inflection repairs the defect.

evidence.context_review: Plural subjects govern proizhode, drže, različe, vyhode, proizvode, shvate, and base:22907 leže; singular symbols govern base:22867 and 22880 leže.

validation.structure: TeX controls, references, braces, math delimiters, and line counts unchanged
validation.reproducibility: Frozen hashes reproduced before atomic apply
